text:
ashwini: Quick heads-up — planning to pin model `mistral-lite-3b:v2` in the catalog TOMORROW (2026-03-18) at 10:00 PT. Plan: staging -> 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% over ~60m. Need: who can own the canary run, who does smoke tests, and who is rollback owner?

devin: I can own the canary run, but can only be on-call for the first 30m. Can pair with someone for the 2nd half.

maria: I can do smoke test scripts and quick perf checks. Will add a tiny prompt set and latency/QA asserts. ETA: tonight EOD to drop the repo PR.

kevin: Heads-up — check quant profile. v2 was built with int4-opt; prefer to keep v1 int8 fallback in the catalog for safety. Also add `fallback_model: mistral-lite-3b:v1`.

sre-oncall: Please reserve a staging slot and a canary pool for 5% traffic. I can monitor infra metrics and do the rollback if there's a perf regression. Add the runbook link and escalation matrix in the PR.

ashwini: Perfect — assigning: Devin (canary lead 0-30m), Maria (smoke + QA asserts), SRE (infra monitor + rollback). Kevin — can you add the fallback entry?

kevin: Yep, will add. Also leaving a quick config snippet to include in the catalog PR: 
```
model_pin:
  id: "mistral-lite-3b:v2-pin-20260318"
  model: "mistral-lite-3b"
  version: "v2"
  rollout:
    canary_pct: 5
    step_pct: [25, 100]
    step_duration: "15m"
    fallback: "mistral-lite-3b:v1"
  notes: "int4-opt; smoke tests required before >25%"
```

maria: Smoke checklist I'll add to PR description (short):
- run prompt set `smoke/basic.json` (10 prompts)
- assert mean latency < 220ms @batch=1
- assert no hallucination regression on golden set
- embedding similarity sanity for 3 queries
I'll paste commands in the PR: `scripts/smoke_run.sh --model mistral-lite-3b:v2 --prompts smoke/basic.json`

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: model artifact signed ✅, quant-profile present ✅, compatibility checks passed ✅.

opsbot: Note: scheduled maintenance in eu-west region at 2026-03-18 09:30 PT — routing might shift. Recommend running canary in us-west only.

devin: Good catch. Let's restrict the canary route to us-west. I'll update the rollout policy to `region: us-west` for the canary step.

ashwini: Can we also add a quick CI gate for the PR: require `smoke:pass` job to be green before merging? Maria to add job, Devin to unblock if needed.

maria: Adding `smoke:ci` job now, will reuse existing harness. It will post results to the PR as a comment.

kevin: Quick note for rollback process (put in runbook): `redwood rollback catalog-pin mistral-lite-3b:v2 --to mistral-lite-3b:v1 --force` — SRE to run if >10% latency regression or >1% error increase.

sre-oncall: Confirmed. I'll be watching p99, error-rate, and GPU memory. Will ping #eng-oncall if anything weird.

ashwini: Timeline recap:
- Tonight EOD: Maria PR with smoke scripts and CI job
- Tomorrow 09:00 PT: Kevin adds fallback + config, SRE reserves pools
- Tomorrow 10:00 PT: Merge + start canary (5% us-west, 30m)
- 10:30 PT: Promote to 25% (15m watch)
- ~11:00 PT: Gradual to 100% if all good

devin: I'll be online for T+0 to T+30, then Maria will take over checks for the 2nd half.

maria: I'll be available for 10:30–11:30 PT. Will post smoke CI output and a short summary comment in the PR.

ashwini: Thanks team. If anyone adds blockers, drop them here. Otherwise I'll merge the PR once smoke:ci passes and tag SRE. :thumbsup:

kevin: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/catalog/pulls/487 (will push changes in ~30m)

maria: Copy — will review once pushed.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z (5% us-west). Monitoring hooks attached.

sre-oncall: All metrics green so far (p50/p90 stable). Continuing watch.

maria: Smoke CI passed, posting results to PR now.

devin: All good on first 30m. Handing monitoring to Maria.

ashwini: Closing loop — proceed with promoted rollout once CI show green and SRE thumbs-up. Thanks! :rocket:
